title: Australian Shirataki Pasta Bake
description: A creamy, cheesy pasta bake with a twist of Australian flavors. This dish combines the low-carb benefits of shirataki noodles with the richness of luxurious cheese.
instructions: Cook the shirataki noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and rinse them.
In a large skillet, sauté the sliced mushrooms in a little bit of oil until they're softened.
In a separate mixing bowl, combine the luxurious cheese, Australian cream cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked pasta and shirataki noodles to the cheese mixture, and stir until everything is well coated.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish, and top it with the sautéed mushrooms.
Bake the pasta bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, and serve hot.
